name: D○gon Ball no Tame nara...... Atashi Ganbaru!
original_name: ド○ゴンボールのためなら……あたしがんばる!
source:
Pretty Bulma went looking for 7 dragon balls in order to make a wish come true: to find true love.
Unfortunately each ball she found already had an owner.
How far is Bulma willing to go in order to get the balls and make her dream come true? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117795.html]DLsite English[/url]]
